where_found: Materials and Methods, 'Planktonic growth and enumeration of bacteria' (the viable plate count method)
quote: Briefly, a 1:10 serial dilution (10^0 to 10^-6) was made in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) in a 96-well plate. Three drops of 10 uL of a selection of dilutions was plated on BA and incubated for minimum of 24 h before colonies were counted and suspensions were enumerated.

caveat: Supersedes the value this project had inferred from the file. The deposited lowest value is 1 with 113 readings on it; 1 is a zero-placeholder, and the next distinct value 2.5 is not the floor either.
